images.filename: Senegal 1 - Cameroon 0 - Stade Léopold Sédar Senghor.jpg
images.caption:
Very famous win for Senegal this evening.  Dakar is going crazy right now.  Horns and drums are blaring.  This match was a qualification match for the African Nations Cup.  Looked like a full house.
Article via Reuters.
First time to use the wide conversion lens and shooting RAW on the Ricoh.  Very happy with the results.  I wish I was able to get closer, but I kept my distance to stay clear of the authorities.

Image was captured by a camera suspended by a kite line. Kite Aerial Photography (KAP)
